criteria.commensurate: At the feature level the trade is large and favorable (40 hh total -66.8%, 15 hh -13.8%, research R15 427.7 -> 83.3 s), but the cost that crossed buys nothing: about 7.2 s idle (14.6 against 7.4 s, reviewer runs) and 2,772 offers for a margin that is rejected anyway. A cost with no functionality behind it is not commensurate, however good the rest of the feature is.
criteria.necessary: Not the part that crossed. The rescue (plan D2, research R6, R9, R15) is asked-for work and earns its keep where it seats: on seeds 25, 6 and 8 at 40 hh it saves margins. But seed 39's +10.3% is a rescue that FAILS: 2 short, it offered 2,772 seats of its 2,784-point sixth-pitch grid, took one at offer 2,555, still fell short, and the margin was thrown away; the seed lands on the same margin 3 with the rescue off (7.4 s). That search changes no outcome.
criteria.no_way_around: There is a cheaper way, measured. Every successful rescue on the sixteen seeds took its houses by offer 512 (seed 25 at 58, 169, 437; seed 6 at 491, 492, 512; seed 8 at 331), so the rescue can take its own dry cap (offer_seats with dry 600 rather than None). Separately, seat_the_rest calls rescue_the_margin when the margin is already full (want - placed <= RESCUE_SHORT holds at 0), building a 2,400-3,900-point grid for nothing on every seed.
